conclusions: All three workflow runs remain terminal failure. The tabulated numbers are job conclusions, not native test totals.

The runtime NPQ6 transport-reset failure is bound to M job 130598328213. H runtime job 130598327706 is described only as success in jobs metadata; its checkout/log was not reread. The M failure is not attributed to H, and H metadata does not erase M's failure.
From-zero/history child failures retain passed=false and systemd_run_exit=1 while child assertion/stderr and product/environment cause remain unknown. No timeout is invented.

The dependency-policy refusal does not assert a particular graph, advisory or vulnerability absent the retained details. The source/hash contract failure does not decide whether implementation or reviewed reference should change.
Repeated schema errors and downstream aggregation refusals are not multiplied into independent causes or combined test counts.

The historical artifact absence remains a retrieval failure with unknown reason. Cancelled macOS jobs retain no observed checkout/execution, unavailable logs and unknown cancellation cause; connector failures are not converted into native failures.
README explicitly makes SOURCE documents historical V1 records and supersedes storage advice only. Original logical .log paths do not authorize raw .log additions to the V2 tree.

The stated complete in-memory reconstruction and three formal remote samples are author verification claims. INDEX explicitly says not all containers received remote readback; README does not claim another CI/whitespace run.
No whole-repository green result, ordinary business closure, independent C adoption, ordinary NoUpdateRollback, or new native success is asserted.
